prompt.en: Ishani votes for the first time. She registered online. At the polling station her disabled brother gets a wheelchair, and volunteers guide the family. She has forgotten her voter ID card and Aadhaar card, and her identity is verified with another document. Her grandmother, aged 89, votes from home. In three or four sentences, name the measures that helped these voters, and say what each one did.

label.en: Online registration put Ishani on the electoral roll before polling day

level1.en: How did Ishani get onto the roll?

clue.en: She used the ECI's online portal.

clue.en: Her identity was verified in another way.

text.en: Online registration put Ishani on the electoral roll before polling day.
An alternative document verified her identity, so her forgotten cards did not stop her voting.
A wheelchair and volunteers helped the family, including her disabled brother, reach the polling booth.
Voting from home let her grandmother, aged 89, vote without travelling to a polling station.

explanation.en: Online registration put Ishani on the roll. An alternative document verified her identity when she forgot her cards. A wheelchair and volunteers helped the family reach the booth. Voting from home let her grandmother vote without travelling. Each measure removed a different difficulty.

hints.en: Go through the story in order, and ask what helped at each point.
Each voter faced a different difficulty.
